items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: I met John Reinhardt and Stephen Corpelli

ctx.x: You know? But I did like Paris; I met John Reinhardt and Stephen Corpelli, and Alex Combelle and oh, Phil Brun and Arthur Briggs -- people like that.

items.title: Carter Benny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And who was the rhythm section? Louis Vola [phonetic] and was it Stefan Grippelli [phonetic] on piano?

ctx.x: He said you quickly sketched out—brilliantly, he added—some basic ensemble parts for Honeysuckle Rose and Crazy Rhythm.
Yeah, I think that’s all we had to do, because I think the rhythm section knew the changes. And who was the rhythm section? Louis Vola [phonetic] and was it Stefan Grippelli [phonetic] on piano?
